title: Latency-Elastic Edge Inference: Predictive Thread-Level QoS on Raspberry Pi 5
description: Code, experiment logs and analysis notebooks for predictive thread-level quality of service (MPC-Lite, a model-predictive thread allocator) for DNN inference on a Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm Cortex-A76). The 2025 manuscript is not under review; the measurements and the controller are released as an artifact.
